productSellingPoint:
Breathable Knitted Textile Upper: Lightweight knitted textile construction supports airflow for casual walking and everyday use.
Regular-Fit Lace-Up Design: Round-toe lace-up construction provides an adjustable everyday fit.
Foamed Sole Construction: A lightweight foamed sole supports flexible daily walking; final material details are confirmed according to the order requirement.
Wholesale Size and Color Options: EU sizes 35-45 are available in black, grey, off white and pink for assortment planning.
OEM ODM Discussion: Logo, insole, color and packaging options can be discussed based on quantity and confirmed requirements.
companyDesc: Quanzhou Beiqiang Footwear & Apparel Co., Ltd. is a footwear factory supplier based in Quanzhou, Fujian, China. We serve importers, wholesalers, online sellers and private-label buyers with casual walking shoes and related footwear. Sample review, mixed size and color requirements, and OEM/ODM options can be discussed according to product availability, quantity, materials, logo and packing requirements. Product details and delivery arrangements are confirmed before order placement.
